verses.text: For the choir director. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Hear this, all peoples; Give ear, all inhabitants of the world,
verses.textZh: （可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。）萬民哪，你們都當聽這話！世上一切的居民，

verses.text: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.
verses.textZh: 無論上流下流，富足貧窮，都當留心聽！

verses.text: My mouth will speak wisdom, And the meditation of my heart [will be] understanding.
verses.textZh: 我口要說智慧的言語；我心要想通達的道理。

verses.text: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle on the harp.
verses.textZh: 我要側耳聽比喻，用琴解謎語。

verses.text: Why should I fear in days of adversity, When the iniquity of my foes surrounds me,
verses.textZh: 在患難的日子，奸惡隨我腳跟，四面環繞我，我何必懼怕？

verses.text: Even those who trust in their wealth And boast in the abundance of their riches?
verses.textZh: 那些倚仗財貨自誇錢財多的人，

verses.text: No man can by any means redeem [his] brother Or give to God a ransom for him--
verses.textZh: 一個也無法贖自己的弟兄，也不能替他將贖價給神，

verses.text: For the redemption of his soul is costly, And he should cease [trying] forever--
verses.textZh: 叫他長遠活著，不見朽壞；因為贖他生命的價值極貴，只可永遠罷休。

verses.text: That he should live on eternally, That he should not undergo decay.
verses.textZh: a

verses.text: For he sees [that even] wise men die; The stupid and the senseless alike perish And leave their wealth to others.
verses.textZh: 他必見智慧人死，又見愚頑人和畜類人一同滅亡，將他們的財貨留給別人。

verses.text: Their inner thought is [that] their houses are forever [And] their dwelling places to all generations; They have called their lands after their own names.
verses.textZh: 他們心裡思想：他們的家室必永存，住宅必留到萬代；他們以自己的名稱自己的地。

verses.text: But man in [his] pomp will not endure; He is like the beasts that perish.
verses.textZh: 但人居尊貴中不能長久，如同死亡的畜類一樣。

verses.text: This is the way of those who are foolish, And of those after them who approve their words. Selah.
verses.textZh: 他們行的這道本為自己的愚昧；但他們以後的人還佩服他們的話語。（細拉）

verses.text: As sheep they are appointed for Sheol; Death shall be their shepherd; And the upright shall rule over them in the morning, And their form shall be for Sheol to consume So that they have no habitation.
verses.textZh: 他們如同羊群派定下陰間；死亡必作他們的牧者。到了早晨，正直人必管轄他們；他們的美容必被陰間所滅，以致無處可存。

verses.text: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, For He will receive me. Selah.
verses.textZh: 只是神必救贖我的靈魂脫離陰間的權柄，因他必收納我。（細拉）

verses.text: Do not be afraid when a man becomes rich, When the glory of his house is increased;
verses.textZh: 見人發財、家室增榮的時候，你不要懼怕；

verses.text: For when he dies he will carry nothing away; His glory will not descend after him.
verses.textZh: 因為，他死的時候甚麼也不能帶去；他的榮耀不能隨他下去。

verses.text: Though while he lives he congratulates himself-- And though [men] praise you when you do well for yourself--
verses.textZh: 他活著的時候，雖然自誇為有福（你若利己，人必誇獎你）；

verses.text: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; They will never see the light.
verses.textZh: 他仍必歸到他歷代的祖宗那裡，永不見光。

verses.text: Man in [his] pomp, yet without understanding, Is like the beasts that perish.
verses.textZh: 人在尊貴中而不醒悟，就如死亡的畜類一樣。
